title: E15 crisis test collects fire_tick but never asserts fire-after-resolve — the headline ordering claim is unverified
detail: fire_tick is assigned but never referenced by any assertion; the test never compares it against the crisis-resolution tick, so an advance firing mid-crisis would still pass every expect in this test.
recommended_fix: Assert fire_tick > the Crisis_Resolved tick (or that no Era_Advanced precedes Crisis_Resolved), and drop the dead variable otherwise.

title: Enter-edge dedup claim ('never every tick') is shipped but no test pins block-event counts
detail: All three block tests assert only boolean presence (saw_sla/saw_legacy/saw_crisis). The zero-demand test asserts no .Sla event at all and window_not_elapsed asserts only zero fires, so the anti-chatter invariant is unpinned.
recommended_fix: Pin exact block-event counts (e.g., exactly one {Sla} per block state) and assert zero block events in the pre-window and zero-demand tests.

title: Tag-14 payload byte added on the write side only — no read-side consumption appears anywhere in the diff
detail: The diff shows the writer emitting a new payload byte for tag 14 but no symmetric reader (r_event_payload or equivalent) consuming it. If events are ever deserialized, tag-14 events misalign the stream.
recommended_fix: Verify the log reader consumes the tag-14 reason byte (or that events are never read back); otherwise add the reader hunk before shipping.

title: Window-elapsed check uses two different tick sources (state.tick vs the tick parameter)
detail: era_step gates on its tick parameter while era_gate_sla_ok re-derives the same precondition from state.tick. If state.tick and tick ever diverge at the S6 seam, the gate evaluates one tick off.
recommended_fix: Use a single tick source for both checks (pass tick into era_gate_sla_ok) or assert state.tick == tick at the era_step entry.

title: Same-tick re-step overwrites the ring slot with zeros, silently erasing that tick from the windowed SLA sums
evidence:
+// Called from era_step every tick the gate is enabled. Same-tick re-step
+// safety: the diff (prev_* scratch) sees delta 0 on a re-step — the accepted
+// 4.2 convention (the ring slot may be overwritten with zeros on a same-tick
+// re-step; the harness drains per step, the app never re-steps, replay never
+// re-steps, so replay equality holds).
detail: On a re-step the slot's prior contribution is subtracted from win_delivered/win_dropped and zeroed — a permanent undercount. The diff's own types.odin notes a pre-existing step_once re-step test convention, so the invariant is fragile.
recommended_fix: Guard the update with a per-tick marker (like growth_last_tick) instead of relying on 'nobody re-steps', or document why gate tests can never re-step.

title: Zero-demand test builds a full gate_fixture, then destroys and rebuilds the run without it — the first setup is dead work
evidence:
+	gate_fixture(&s, cat) // topology only — the director spawns NOTHING (no demand)
+	run_destroy(&s)
+	run_init(&s, 1, cat.hash, TEST_LOGIC_HZ)
detail: The test calls gate_fixture (spawns three nodes, draws two pipes via sla_draw), then immediately run_destroy + run_init and rebuilds without draws. The fixture's effect is entirely discarded; only the second setup runs.
recommended_fix: Delete the initial gate_fixture call and its setup comment; construct the node-only state directly on first run_init.
